definitions.gloss: long night; the long nights of autumn
definitions.explanation: The long nights of the season when darkness comes early. Almost always heard in the set phrase {秋|あき}の{夜長|よなが}, the long autumn evenings, thought of as a time for reading or quiet pastimes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{夜長|よなが}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{読書|どくしょ}→読書：03484_dokusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: To enjoy reading on a long autumn evening.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{夜長|よなが}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}き→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ちょうどいい→ちょうどいい：21521_choudoii⟧。
examples.english: The long autumn nights are just right for reading a book at leisure while listening to the insects.

notes:
A seasonal word (⟦{季語|きご}→季語：09561_kigo⟧) for autumn. Its spring counterpart is {日長|ひなが}, the lengthening days.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{夜長|よなが}: the long autumn nights
- ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{夜長|よなが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧: to enjoy the long autumn evenings
- {夜長|よなが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{読書|どくしょ}→読書：03484_dokusho⟧: reading on a long night
